build_bitonic_communication_pattern: build a bitonic sort communication pattern for a hypercube of size 2 to the power of num_bits
create_fixed_network_from_list: create a fixed sorting network communication pattern from a list of comparator stages
generate_batcher_bitonic_pattern: generate a Batcher bitonic communication pattern for an array of arbitrary length
prune_sorting_network: prune comparators from a sorting network keeping only wires in the given set
parallelize_sorting_network: parallelize sorting network comparators by organizing them into stages that can run in parallel
